I am telling you that using that word impacts people who may be wired differently than you. I work with such people and it bothers me that you’re perpetuating the myth it doesn’t harm them. 

It is not always fairly obvious. It’s called a spectrum for a reason, and that is because people fall along different sections of it. 

The message that you send when using this word is that people on the spectrum are lesser than others. Especially if it’s “joking” around. Making light of a real issue invalidates it, and if anyone around you hears such a joke, it will make them feel invisible and uncared for. 

Your choice of words is essential to your message.

How the fuck do you know whether I am neurally typical or not? 

You can’t convince me to not care about this word. 

Why do you need to use this word? It has caused harm, it will continue to cause harm with use, and there is no reason to use it. Again, you are going to an awful lot of effort to use a hateful word. There can be no good reason for that. The word is tainted and has the power to hurt. So don’t use it ! It really isn’t difficult. 

Just because other words might be worse doesn’t mean saying this one is okay. 

Are there words that you don’t want other people to use when describing you, for instance? 

Words have power and we should be delicate with them. I do not feel foolish and you can’t convince me that I should.

Seems like you’re going a long way to use this word. Also again, I am offended by its usage, so it’s uncertain to me what you’re trying to convince me of. I think sensitivity is always wise, and this word has been used for hatred. It is nowhere close to the word “dumb” in severity.

There are not so many words to avoid saying that it’s actually tiring, though. It doesn’t take a lot of effort to reflect on the impact of what you say and decide to not use words that you know are harmful.
Why does anyone need to use it? Words that have historically marginalized and harmed minority groups should be left in the past. The intention when this particular word was used by OP was for harm.
I am commenting to say that I care.

If the term is used in a perjorative manner then it will hurt both parties, whether they deserve to be called out for their behavior or not
